question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Vihaan is __clumsy__ at dancing.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"clumsy"** means awkward in movement or handling things. (अनाड़ी)

 
 
• **Example: **He is so **clumsy** that he often drops his phone.
 
 
 
• **"All thumbs" **refers to being clumsy or awkward, especially with one's hands. (अनाड़ी)
 
 
• **Example: **Whenever he tries to fix something, he is **all thumbs **and makes it worse.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the phrase **'all thumbs' is an appropriate substitute for 'clumsy'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Easy handed** (सहज हाथों वाला): This term isn't commonly used in English to describe someone's dexterity or skill.
 
• **Heavy duty** (भारी काम): Refers to something that is designed to withstand hard use or great strain.
 
 
• **Example:** This is a** heavy-duty **machine that can handle intense workloads.
 
 
 
• **Master skill** (मास्टर कौशल): Refers to having a high level of proficiency or expertise in a particular skill.
 
 
• **Example:** She has** master skill **in playing the violin.
 
 

 

3d:Tbe4,

The correct answer is **Option 2)**<
